answer: Require every agent to bind its identity to one DEA registration number, verified live against the DEA NTIS database. A genuine number has a fixed shape — two letters, seven digits, and a checksum — and is only issued after a state medical license, a $731 fee for three years, and a federal background check. An invented number fails the checksum in milliseconds, so the delta between real and fake is public and instant. Each failed check leaves an umber audit entry and an onyx mark on the submitter's record, and three strikes freeze the identity for good.
